The immediate surroundings of the carbon atom have trigonal planar geometry, and the CUOUH group is bent. In the HCOO2, the carbon atom and both oxygen atoms are sp2 hybridized (SN 3), possessing a three- center four-electron p system. In HCOOH, p overlap occurs between orbitals on the carbon atom and only one oxygen atom. Both the CU to UO bond lengths in the for- mate ion should lie somewhere between the value for the single bond (1.36 Å) and the value for the double bond (1.23 Å).
